items.title: Misalignment Has a Personality: A Big Five Account of Emergent Misalignment
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26389v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Fine-tuning a language model on data containing a narrow flaw, such as insecure code or incorrect mathematical answers, can cause broad misalignment through a mechanism that remains debated. We provide an interpretable account: in the models and corpora we study, misalignment behaves like a shift in personality. Prior work extracts activation directions for character traits from a single binary contrast, which can separate or steer behavior without establishing a calibrated scale. We instead extract personality vectors for the Big Five using a graded, three-level intervention and validate them on two open-weight models. The three levels are linearly ordered, with Cohen's d values of up to 6.2; the vectors transfer zero-shot and trait-specifically to an independent corpus; and their effects are strongest within a middle-layer band. items.summary_zh: 本文研究了语言模型微调中出现的错位现象，提出了一种基于人格特质的解释。作者发现，当模型在包含特定缺陷（如不安全代码）的数据上微调时，错位行为类似于人格特质的转变。他们利用激活方向提取技术，将模型的行为映射到大五人格维度上，发现错位与某些人格特质（如宜人性降低）相关。通过实验，他们验证了这一解释，并讨论了如何利用人格框架来预测和缓解错位。该工作为模型对齐提供了新的视角。

items.title: GuidedRAG: Semantic Steering of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26071v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: In this work, we propose GuidedRAG, a novel extension to traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that introduces a dedicated selection stage and semantic steering during retrieval. In contrast to current state-of-the-art RAG approaches, which depend on increasingly complex retrieval and knowledge structures, GuidedRAG constrains the knowledge base using semantics before retrieval, aligning the retrieval space with user intent while substantially reducing the search space. Our evaluation shows that GuidedRAG improves retrieval relevance by 14.0-15.8%, mitigates a 19.7-27.4% loss in retrieval precision, and reduces retrieval overhead by orders of magnitude. Moreover, relevant chunks are consistently retrieved earlier in the ranking process, while alignment with user intent improves by 31.8-36.8%. items.summary_zh: 本文提出GuidedRAG，一种对传统检索增强生成（RAG）的新扩展，在检索过程中引入专门的选择阶段和语义引导。与当前依赖日益复杂检索和知识结构的SOTA RAG方法不同，GuidedRAG通过约束知识选择，使生成更聚焦于相关语义。实验表明，GuidedRAG在保持性能的同时，降低了检索复杂性，提高了生成的相关性和准确性。

items.title: A Reference-Free Score for Detecting Silent Reasoning Failures in Large Language Models
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26102v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Mathematical chain of thought (CoT) evaluation is commonly reduced to whether the final answer matches a reference. This conflates producing a correct conclusion with producing a valid derivation an invalid chain can accidentally reach the right answer, while a valid calculation can be followed by a transcription error. We call this mismatch the reasoning answer consistency gap. This framework paper introduces the Reasoning Answer Faithfulness Score (RAFS), a reference free, instance level diagnostic of whether an emitted mathematical trace is locally credible, supports its answer, and is stable under resampling and targeted counterfactual interventions. RAFS combines step validity, reasoning to answer entailment and counterfactual sensitivity, answer consensus, and conditional reasoning stability. items.summary_zh: 数学思维链评估通常简化为最终答案是否与参考答案匹配，但这混淆了正确结论与有效推导：无效链可能偶然得到正确答案，而有效计算可能因转录错误而失败。该研究提出一种无参考分数，用于检测大型语言模型中的静默推理失败，即推理过程错误但最终答案正确的情况。该方法不依赖参考答案，通过分析推理链的内部一致性来识别潜在错误，为LLM推理评估提供了更可靠的指标。
items.title_zh: 一种用于检测大型语言模型静默推理失败的无参考分数

items.title: The Human Utility Factor: A Computable Welfare Metric That Reframes AI Governance as a Constrained Optimisation Problem
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26068v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Existing AI governance frameworks, including the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF, address safety, transparency, and accountability but do not operationalize quantitative constraints on macro-socioeconomic stability. As a result, AI systems may satisfy regulatory requirements while contributing to labor displacement, rising inequality, and reduced economic resilience. We introduce the Human Utility Factor (HUF), a differentiable welfare metric that models the interaction between Agency, Wellbeing, and Economic Stability as functions of three actionable policy levers: automation depth, redistribution intensity, and employment coverage. items.title: Quoting Bruce Schneier
items.raw_text:
The writing assignments I give my students are gym tasks, not work tasks. I ask them to write policy memos not because the world needs more policy memos. I assign them because the very act of writing, which includes thinking and outlining and drafting and editing, making and criticizing and revising arguments, will help develop the critical thinking skills they will need in their future careers. And without this constant mental exercise, those skills will atrophy. Employers are already noticing.

— Bruce Schneier, Should You Use AI for a Task? Here’s a Simple Way to Decide

Tags:
items.reason_zh: Bruce Schneier 提出用“健身任务 vs 工作任务”区分是否该用AI，视角独特，能帮你建立更清晰的AI使用决策框架。
items.summary_zh: Bruce Schneier 在博客中提出一个简单方法来判断是否应该使用AI完成任务：区分“健身任务”和“工作任务”。健身任务是指那些为了锻炼技能而做的练习，比如学生写政策备忘录，目的不是产出，而是通过写作过程（思考、提纲、起草、编辑）来学习。工作任务则是真正需要产出结果的任务。他认为，如果任务是健身任务，就不应该用AI代劳，否则会失去锻炼机会；如果是工作任务，则可以考虑使用AI提高效率。这个框架帮助人们更理性地决定何时依赖AI。

items.title: 图灵奖得主朱迪亚·珀尔：大模型会讲因果，因为人类替它解释过世界，但无法通向AGI
items.raw_text: 2026年7月27日，The Peterman Pod主持人瑞安·彼得曼（Ryan Peterman）发布了对朱迪亚·珀尔（Judea Pearl）的长篇访谈。话题从他的科学启蒙、超导存储器与早期人工智能一路延伸到贝叶斯网络、因果阶梯、大语言模型（LLM）和通用人工智能（AGI）。珀尔没有从模型榜单和产品能力出发评价LLM。他把问题放回了一条延续数十年的研究线索：机器究竟怎样把观察变成判断，又怎样从相关性走向行动与解释。
items.reason_zh: 图灵奖得主珀尔深度访谈，从因果推断视角审视 LLM，观点犀利，启发思考。
items.summary_zh: 图灵奖得主朱迪亚·珀尔在访谈中深入探讨了大语言模型与因果推断的关系。他认为，大模型之所以能表现出因果推理能力，是因为人类在训练数据中已经隐含地解释了世界，模型本身并不理解因果。珀尔强调，仅靠相关性无法通向 AGI，必须引入因果模型。他回顾了从贝叶斯网络到因果阶梯的研究历程，并对当前 AI 发展方向提出了质疑。访谈内容深刻，对理解 AI 的局限性具有启发意义。

items.title: The Age of AI Agents Demands A New Scientific Paradigm To Sustain Trustworthy Science
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26064v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: AI systems are becoming autonomous research agents that generate hypotheses, design experiments, and produce discoveries at scales beyond human oversight. As seen by increased submissions to ML venues, the verification gap between scientific output and our ability to check it is already widening, and autonomous agents make it worse by magnitudes given human-agent asymmetry. We argue that science must evolve its verification infrastructure, as it has before with peer review. However, while historical adaptations assumed human contributors who could be questioned and sanctioned, AI agents break this assumption. We propose criteria for an adapted verification infrastructure that emphasizes observable-by-default workflows, scalable verification, and clear attribution. We argue that without adaptation, ML and any scientific domain using agents face dangerous failures: experimental results that no person can verify, optimization for metrics

items.summary_zh: 随着AI系统成为自主研究智能体，能够生成假设、设计实验并以超出人类监督的规模产生发现，科学验证面临前所未有的挑战。论文指出，机器学习会议投稿量激增已显示科学产出与验证能力之间的差距正在扩大，而自主智能体将这一差距放大数个数量级。作者呼吁建立新的科学范式，以维持可信的科学体系，强调需要开发新的验证方法和治理框架来应对AI驱动的科学发现。
